subject: design/feature-draft-v1
statement: A draft lives on one pushed branch with a draft pull request from its first round; each round is a push, and the approved squash merge is the lock, whose merge commit is locked version N. A change to a locked feature opens a new draft branch from the mainline while version N stays binding; the next lock replaces it, and the replaced version stays readable by rendering memory as of its lock commit (`design-brainstorm:feature-draft-tech-design#D-2`; `prd:feature-draft/FR-20`, `FR-21`, `FR-22`).
